comparison_model: Steel renewal for ice strengthened structures is required when the gauged thickness is less than tnet + 0.5 mm.
source_basis: IACS UR I2.11.4: steel renewal is required when gauged thickness < tnet + 0.5 mm.

cases.rationale: At exact tnet+0.5 mm boundary, gauged thickness is not less than the trigger; renewal=false.
cases.oracle: Trigger is strict gaugedThickness < netThickness + 0.0005 m; steelRenewalRequired must equal the trigger result.
